complexity.notes: s.lower() creates an O(n) copy; comparing characters case-insensitively inline (e.g., via s[a].lower()) would give O(1) auxiliary space. The inner right-pointer loop could in theory be guarded against underflow for clarity, though it is safe here since the left pointer always rests on an alphanumeric character first.
complexity.summary: Two-pointer scan from both ends of the lowercased string, skipping non-alphanumeric characters and comparing the remaining characters pairwise.
